011-2. NOT AN OUNCE OF MEMORY LEFT? EVEN HER HOME- TOWN?
011-3. WELL.FROMTHE EARLIEST REACHES OF HER MEMORY,SHE HAS BEEN FOLLOWING AN SCAVENGER OLDLADY,

011-5. THEY WERE EVEN CHASED AWAY SOMETIMES SINCE IT MAKES THE CITY LOOK BAD.
011-6. IT'S HARD WHEN SHE DOESN'T REMEMBER A THING. WITHOUT A LICK OFINFO.EVEN THE CEN- SUS DEPARTMENT CAN'T DO A THING.
011-7. DAD，I'VE ALREADY THOUGHT OF ALL SORTS OF NORMAL WAYS TO DEAL WITH THIS,
011-8. THE REASON THAT I'M LOOKING FOR YOU IS BE- CAUSE..
011-9. BECALSE OF WHAT? DOYOU WANT ME TO COM- MIT A CRIME?
011-10. THINK CAREFULLY, THERE MIGHT BE SOMETHING THAT YOUMISSED...

Page 012
012-1. FORGETIT, I SHOULD JUST ASK JIANG HE MYSELF.
012-2. I REALLY DIDN'T MISS OUT ON ANY- THINGI'VE ALREADY TOLD YOU EVERY- THING I CAN TELL YOU.
012-3. DOES THAT MEAN THERE IS SOME STUFF THAT YOU CANT TELL ME ABOUT?
012-4. OFCOURSEHE WON'TSAYA THING IF HE HASSOMETHINGTOHIDE. IF HEJUSTANSWERSAFTER ME ASKING,WHICHOFUS WILL BE THE STUPID ONE IN THATCASE?
012-5. 纯情的眼神
012-6. REGARDLESS OF WHETHER THERE ISOR ISN'T,THATQUESTION WAS A DUMB ONE!
